CustomField.description: Set to true by the LOVING_Aqua_Delivery_QC_Submit flow when a Delivery_Quality_Check__c record is submitted for this work order with Overall_Pass__c = true. Required because WorkOrder formula fields cannot directly reference child record fields — this checkbox is the writeback mechanism. Used in Delivery_QC_Status__c formula to determine if QC was completed. If Overall_Pass__c = false on the DQC, this field stays false and Delivery_QC_Status__c = Pending until FM resolves the issue.
CustomField.label: Delivery QC Complete
